label: PoE 1 3.29
notes: Publishes implementation changes made since r16: item queries can match enchantment lines and intangible items and read a missing Quality on trade items as 0%, and the bundled market reference data is current. The 3.30.0 recombination, Orb of Annulment and Incursion modifier rules are included but apply only to 3.30 catalogs. The data packages' manifest schema accepts PoE 2's 0.x client builds. Extracted crafting data and the 3.29 crafting mechanics are unchanged. Revisions r1 through r16 retain their original immutable engines and preset graphs.

label: PoE 2 (client 4.5)
notes: Publishes the shared implementation changes made since r16 with no change to PoE 2 crafting mechanics. The data packages' manifest schema accepts PoE 2's 0.x client builds. Revisions r1 through r16 retain their original immutable engines and behavior; equipment prices remain manual.
